Wasmer SDK
==========

Package: @wasmer/sdk 0.18.0
Source: https://github.com/wasmerio/wasmer-sdk/tree/wasmer-sdk-js-v0.18.0
Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@wasmer/sdk/-/sdk-0.18.0.tgz
SHA-256: edb2faded9c529f16df80be7e4a368ae4bac23bc24c6a22843f8778c2c7bf8e4
SHA-512: umeaf9asTL5xS6Sp6D3tDiO4v/B3Z7gLsLWra0BDKkThX0+XTZWhb5nl77sqlfTUjTSxOLpBN7xQivNSsBLQBQ==
License: Modified MIT. See LICENSE for the Wasmer credit requirement.

The browser entry, thread, and bridge modules in dist are copied verbatim.
The pkg tree is copied from the verified tarball with one CSP patch below.
The package includes Acorn and its license in pkg/snippets.
The vendor lock records each file hash.

Audit
-----
The SDK can use fetch, browser storage, native Workers, eval, and Function.
Its N-API context can reach browser globals. Network policy alone does not
isolate those operations. Each peerd Wasmer worker applies the Pod realm
seal before it imports SDK code. The supervisor uses a Worker relay. The
trusted Pod host creates all native workers and stops them together.
Thread initialization accepts only the packaged SDK URL.

peerd supplies local module bytes, a compiled runtime, and a workspace copy.
It disables SDK cache and networking. It does not use registry names, WISP,
host filesystem bridges, service worker hosts, or browser port exposure.
Node, WISP, and service worker modules are omitted. Their imports are not reached.
WEBC dependencies that need network access fail in the sealed realm.
Edge.js needs JavaScript evaluation and is not supported under MV3 CSP.

CSP patch
---------
pkg/wasmer_sdk_js.js replaces its new Function binding with a static function.
It accepts exactly parameter "f" and body
"return f(Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1))".
All other parameter or body strings throw EvalError. No eval is added.
The static adapter passes the remaining arguments as one array to f.
Upstream creates this fixed callback in its synchronous and JSPI host adapters:
https://github.com/wasmerio/wasmer/blob/cc07dc0b35b55a48d1995b9df2ded8d3aa82b06f/lib/api/src/backend/js/entities/function/mod.rs
The Wasmer SDK Cargo.toml pins that source revision.
Original JS SHA-256: 9a74f58bcf5c8693e95219656b68ab85ba72981ff5a0629c9cd77bfd13c7cdbc
Patched JS SHA-256: c58218fd48f215c91875b1125b99bf3fb38c4a14c2e386f8174095d1088776ab

To update, verify the registry tarball integrity, review all changed SDK code,
replace these trees and notices, and run the vendor lock generator.
